notes: SALES AGENTS & COMMISSIONS ENGINE (2026-08-23, PR-C, branch feat/sales-agents-engine; INDEX.md row + api.md `sales-agents/` section). Ships DARK: flag.sales_agents is granted ONLY by the SALES_AGENTS addon (catalog v10, no plan grants it), so the engine returns before touching a commission table and both controllers 403 until an admin enables it per tenant. NEW apps/api/src/sales-agents/: commission-math.ts (pure) + commission-engine.service.ts + commission-reconciliation.service.ts (@Cron "30 * * * *") + sales-agents + commission-statements controllers/services, all in commissions.module.ts which exports ONLY CommissionEngineService (consumers import one-way; no forwardRef). Money (owner-locked): base = max(0, subtotal - discount), tax and shipping NEVER enter, computed ONCE per document; a CREDIT_NOTE application reduces the base by its PRE-TAX share (creditApplied x goods/total), not face value; payable releases pro-rata with cash and only status=PAID InvoicePayment rows count (the DRAFT-payment trap) - a deliberate divergence from recomputeStatus, which filters only != VOID. Ledger invariant: drift = payable - claimedAmount - SUM(adjustments); rows stay mutable until claimed, claims move only via statements, and drift < -eps appends exactly ONE self-limiting CommissionAdjustment - which is why backdating, clawbacks, reassignment and order edits are all one code path. Schema migration 20260901000000_add_sales_agents_commissions: 9 models + 6 enums + Order.commissionRatePct, with @@unique([tenantId, invoiceId, agentId]) as the double-accrual lock and a hand-appended partial unique index AgentAssignment_open_assignment_key (one OPEN assignment per customer; Prisma DSL cannot express it). ~18 one-line syncInvoiceCommissionSafe hooks across invoices/credit-notes/orders - the wrapper NEVER throws (a commission bug must not block a payment write) and the hourly cron heals what it swallows; revertInvoiceToDraft/reopenInvoice/writeOff were wrapped in a tenantTransaction for this, and OrdersService.deleteOrder's invoice cascade was a real bypass (it hard-deletes invoices without going through deleteInvoice). WATCH OUT: every TestingModule building InvoicesService/CreditNotesService/OrdersService now needs a CommissionEngineService mock or Nest DI fails at beforeEach. Onboarding IS backdating - enabling the addon creates no retroactive accruals; bulk-assign + a backdated rate + recomputeCommissionRange builds the history, so there is no backfill script by design. No web/mobile UI - that is PR-D. REVIEW FIXES (same PR): adjustment kind is picked by CAUSE, not by the forced-zero target - an un-issued invoice (void / revert-to-draft / reopen) emits CLAWBACK, which the old heuristic mislabelled RATE_CHANGE on every void; a resolved agent at rate 0 (rateSource NONE, or an explicit 0 = exempt order override) KEEPS its placeholder row - only rows that stopped EARNING are deleted - so those syncs are genuinely idempotent instead of delete/recreate churn; and a new accrual row is inserted after a findFirst re-check of the double-accrual lock rather than by catching P2002, because inside the caller's tx Postgres aborts the WHOLE transaction on a constraint violation and swallowing it would only defer the failure to COMMIT (the one thing the ...Safe wrapper cannot save a caller from). || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory; one dated bullet per session, newest first).
